File No. INF26-20889
Resolution making certain changes in the budget of the City of Tampa for the 
fiscal year ending September 30, 2026; approving the transfer, reallocation 
and/or appropriation of $21,495,000 within the Stormwater Bond Series 2023 
Fund for the South Howard Flood Relief and Streetscape Project; providing an 
effective date.
BACKGROUND:
This financial resolution reallocates $20,895,000 from the Lower Peninsula Watershed Plan 
and $600,000 of earned interest from the capital outlay budget reserve for a total of 
$21,495,000 within the Stormwater Bond Series 2023 Fund for the South Howard Flood 
Relief and Streetscape Project.
FISCAL IMPACT: Yes
FISCAL IMPACT STATEMENT:
This financial resolution reallocates $20,895,000 from the Lower Peninsula Watershed Plan 
and $600,000 of earned interest from the capital outlay budget reserve for a total of 
$21,495,000 within the Stormwater Bond Series 2023 Fund for the South Howard Flood 
Relief and Streetscape Project.
